info.title: European & German E-Invoicing Service
info.description: Business operations on electronic invoices: validate, generate, read, convert, and render. Endpoints are organized by what the caller wants to do with an invoice, not by the underlying standard or engine. Supported standards and their pinned versions are reported by GET /v1/capabilities. Marketplace customers can sign in and manage API keys at https://invoice-service-api.simon-ai-enterprise.de/portal.

CreditTransferDto.description:
BG-17 CREDIT TRANSFER. `AccountId` is BT-84, `AccountName` is BT-85 and
`ServiceProviderId` is BT-86, the BIC of the bank holding that one account.

name.description: BT-70, the name of the party the goods are delivered to.

locationSchemeIdentifier.description: BT-71-1, the scheme the delivery location identifier is drawn from.

taxPointDate.description: BT-7, the date on which VAT becomes accountable.

taxPointDateCode.description: BT-8, the VAT point date code from UNTDID 2005.

note.description: BT-127, a free-text note about the line.

priceBaseQuantity.description: BT-149, the quantity the net unit price applies to.

priceBaseQuantityUnitCode.description: BT-150, the unit of measure of BT-149.

priceDiscount.description: BT-147, the discount subtracted from BT-148 to arrive at BT-146.

subLines.description:
BG-DEX-01 SUB INVOICE LINE, an XRechnung Extension term. A sub line carries the same terms
as the line it hangs under, including its own sub lines, and its BT-131 is already part of
the parent's — so the group breaks a line down rather than adding to the invoice.

InvoiceNoteDto.description:
BG-1 INVOICE NOTE: the note text BT-22 and, optionally, the BT-21 subject code saying what the
note is about. `SubjectCode` defaults to null, so a caller with plain notes states only the
text.

InvoicingPeriodDto.description:
A date range: BG-14 INVOICING PERIOD (BT-73 / BT-74) on the header and BG-26 INVOICE LINE PERIOD
(BT-134 / BT-135) on a line. Both ends are optional because EN 16931 requires only one of them.

countryOfOrigin.description: BT-159, the country the item originates from.

OperationCapabilityDto.description:
The profiles one operation supports, which is not always the profile list of the standard:
ZUGFeRD MINIMUM and BASIC WL validate and render but cannot be read or generated, because
neither schema declares an invoice line.

additionalLegalInformation.description: BT-33, additional legal information about the seller.

PayeeDto.description:
BG-10 PAYEE: the party to be paid when that is not the seller. `Name` is BT-59,
`Identifier` is BT-60/BT-60-1 and `LegalRegistrationIdentifier` is BT-61/BT-61-1.

PrecedingInvoiceReferenceDto.description: BG-3 PRECEDING INVOICE REFERENCE. `InvoiceId` is BT-25, `IssueDate` is BT-26.

schemeVersionIdentifier.description:
The version of the scheme, BT-158-2 being the only term EN 16931 names for it. It is optional
on every identifier because the normative binding treats it that way.

QualifiedIdentifierDto.description: An identifier together with the scheme it is drawn from.

MarketplaceApiKey.description: Google Cloud Marketplace API key (imp_...). Create it in the customer portal after signing up through Google Cloud Marketplace.
MarketplaceApiKey.name: X-API-Key
